angle_en: Krishna names the slain warriors to push Arjuna to fight
angle_hi: कृष्ण मारे गए योद्धाओं के नाम लेकर अर्जुन को युद्ध करने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं

en.intro: Arjuna has just seen the whole universe in one form. Now Krishna names the very warriors he fears, and tells him what to do.
en.notice: Krishna names four of Arjuna's greatest teachers and rivals, Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, and Karna, and says they have already been slain by Him. He then commands Arjuna to stop trembling and simply be the instrument to finish them.
en.next: Sanjaya hears Arjuna's choked voice as he folds his hands and bows to Krishna, terrified by what he has just seen.
en.meaning: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and the other great warriors have already been slain by Me. Do not falter; fight, and you will surely conquer your enemies in battle.

hi.intro: अध्याय ग्यारह में अर्जुन ने विराट रूप देखा है। अब कृष्ण उन योद्धाओं के नाम लेते हैं जिनसे अर्जुन डरता है, और उसे आदेश देते हैं।
hi.meaning: कृष्ण कहते हैं, हे अर्जुन, द्रोण, भीष्म, जयद्रथ, कर्ण तथा अन्य सभी महान योद्धाओं को मैंने पहले ही मार डाला है। तुम व्यथा मत करो, युद्ध करो, और तुम युद्ध में अपने शत्रुओं को निःसन्देह जीत लोगे।
hi.notice: कृष्ण द्रोण, भीष्म, जयद्रथ और कर्ण के नाम लेते हैं, जो अर्जुन के गुरु और शत्रु हैं, और कहते हैं कि उन्हें मैंने पहले ही मार डाला है। फिर वे अर्जुन को आदेश देते हैं कि वह व्यथा न करे और युद्ध करे।
hi.next: संजय कहते हैं कि अर्जुन कृष्ण के इन शब्दों को सुनकर कांपने लगा, हाथ जोड़कर बार-बार प्रणाम किया, और भय से कांपती हुई आवाज में कृष्ण से बात की।

en.intro: Arjuna has just seen the whole universe in one form. Now Krishna names the very warriors he fears, and tells him what to do.
en.body: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and the other great warriors have already been slain by Me. Do not falter; fight, and you will surely conquer your enemies in battle. Krishna names four of Arjuna's greatest teachers and rivals, Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, and Karna, and says they have already been slain by Him. He then commands Arjuna to stop trembling and simply be the instrument to finish them. Sanjaya hears Arjuna's choked voice as he folds his hands and bows to Krishna, terrified by what he has just seen.

issues: meaning_changed: "तुम व्यथा मत करो और युद्ध करो ।  युद्धमें तुम निःसन्देह वैरियोंको जीतोगे ॥" (The Hindi meaning drops the conditional 'fight, and you will surely conquer your enemies in battle' and instead commands 'fight, and you will undoubtedly win your enemies in battle', changing the nuance from a promise of guaranteed victory if Arjuna fights to a direct command to win.)

borrowed: "become only the instrument, Arjuna" (This phrase is borrowed from the PREVIOUS verse (33). It is presented in the INTRO/NOTICE as part of the meaning/command of this verse (34), which misstates what this specific verse says.)
